title: A Love So Beautiful
overview: Love is as tough as it is sweet for a lovestruck teenager, whose relationship with her next-door neighbor transforms as they grow into adulthood.

title: Affair
overview: A wealthy individual's life is upended by family bankruptcy. Their childhood friend, Wanwiwa, becomes a source of comfort. Years later, they reunite, reigniting old memories and feelings amidst changed circumstances.

title: An Astrological Guide for Broken Hearts
overview: Alice is heartbroken and hopelessly single. But after befriending a charismatic astrology guru, she looks to the stars to find her perfect match.

title: An Incurable Case of Love
overview: Nanase fell in love with Dr. Tendo five years ago. Now she's a nurse and ready to meet him again. But he's nothing like the nice guy she thought he was!

title: Beyond Goodbye
overview: After losing her fiancé in an accident, Saeko feels an inexplicable connection to a stranger — who, by a twist of fate, received his heart and memories.

title: Chastity High
overview: When an ultra-elite high school enforces a strict "No Romance" rule that expels anyone caught dating, a student secretly helps her classmates for cash.

title: Class Crush Crisis
overview: After transferring to a top high school, aspiring rock star Leerit vows to avoid romance — but quickly changes his tune when he meets his new roommate.

title: Dare You to Death
overview: When seven college students find themselves trapped in a deadly game, two detectives compete to find the killer — even as their attraction grows.

title: Feel Good
overview: Recovering addict and comedian Mae tries to control the addictive behaviors and intense romanticism that permeate every facet of their life. Life is further complicated by a new and all-consuming relationship with their new girlfriend George.

title: First Love
overview: Young, free and madly in love. As teenagers, the world was their oyster—but, as adults, their lives seem dimmer, like a very important piece is missing.

title: From Me to You: Kimi ni Todoke
overview: With her gloomy demeanor, Sawako has a hard time fitting in. But when an outgoing classmate approaches her, life takes a turn for the better.

title: Gimbap and Onigiri
overview: A disillusioned former college track star working at a diner meets a tired Korean animation student struggling to find housing in Japan, and they instantly connect over an emotional moment involving a rice ball.

title: Harmony Secret
overview: Two business heiresses—Aiwarin and Maevika—from a hotel empire and from a department store dynasty, respectively, compete for a national Duty-Free bid. From the moment they meet, an undeniable attraction sparks.

title: Home for Christmas
overview: 30-something Johanne navigates romance and family drama during the festive season, juggling exes and new relationships in her search for connection.

title: Hometown Romance
overview: Si, a high-society heiress, dreams of becoming the president of her family’s company. However, her parents give the position to her younger sister instead, believing Si is too spoiled and irresponsible, spending millions without a second thought. When the family business faces a crisis involving a crucial land lease renewal, negotiations fail—until Klaokavee, the landowner, makes an unusual proposal: she will renew the lease only if Si agrees to marry her. Despite their completely opposite lifestyles, this strange arrangement brings the two into an unexpected and complicated relationship.

title: I Wanna Be Sup'Tar
overview: A disgraced superstar with nothing left ends up living under the same roof as an ordinary supporting actress. As house rules pile up and egos collide, their dysfunctional cohabitation spirals into sharp humor, constant friction, and consequences neither can avoid.

title: If I Hadn't Met You
overview: Eduard, a husband and father who loses his family in a tragic accident, travels to parallel universes to seek a better fate for his beloved wife.

title: If Only
overview: Follow the story of a 30-year-old woman who, when feeling dissatisfied with her marriage and family life, finds herself sent back in time 10 years following a lunar eclipse.

title: Long Vacation
overview: Minami who is dumped by her ex-boyfriend, Asakura, on their wedding day. She later meets Sena, Asakura's ex-roommate and a pianist, and lives with him as she has no other place to stay. What will happen to her during this long vacation?

title: Love & Anarchy
overview: A married consultant and a young IT tech kick off a flirty game that challenges societal norms — and leads them to re-evaluate their entire lives.

title: Love Life
overview: A romantic comedy anthology series which follows a different protagonist each season on the journey from first love to last love, with each half-hour episode chronicling one of their relationships.

title: Love to Hate You
overview: For an attorney who despises losing to men and an A-list actor who distrusts women, love means nothing — until they're forced to date each other.

title: Lovers Anonymous
overview: Cem, scarred by a childhood that crushed his trust in love, runs the "Love Hospital" — until Hazal, a believer in the power of love, disrupts his life.

title: Lovestruck in the City
overview: Heart stolen by a free-spirited woman after a beachside romance, a passionate architect sets out to reunite with her on the streets of Seoul.

title: Luna Nera
overview: In 17th-century Italy, a teenager learns about her destiny among a family of witches, just as her boyfriend's father hunts her down for witchcraft.

title: Mad for Each Other
overview: Bothered to realize they are next-door neighbors and share a psychiatrist, a man and a woman find it's impossible to stay out of each other's way.

title: Melo Movie
overview: A movie buff falls for an aspiring director, igniting a romance that fizzles out too soon. When their paths cross again, can love find its way back?

title: My Korean Boyfriend
overview: Five Brazilian women, in various stages of their relationships, arrive in bustling Seoul to discover if their relationships can survive the distance, cultural differences, and new routines.

title: Once Upon a Small Town
overview: Against his wishes a veterinarian from the big city relocates to the countryside, where he meets a policewoman, a town insider with a friendly secret.

title: Ready, Set, Love
overview: In a world grappling with a dwindling male population, an unassuming woman becomes a contender in a government-sponsored dating competition.

title: Replacing Chef Chico
overview: When a head chef falls into a coma, it's up to his devoted sous-chef to keep their Filipino fine dining restaurant from closing down.

title: Romantics Anonymous
overview: A brilliant chocolatier who's afraid of making eye contact meets an heir who can't touch others — but somehow, they're immune to each other.

title: S&X
overview: At his clinic, sex therapist Ichito Shimotori treats diverse and intimate sexual issues with sincerity. Yet, he secretly hides a struggle of his own.

title: Sexy Beasts
overview: Hoping to say goodbye to superficial dating, real-life singles sport elaborate makeup and prosthetics to put true blind-date chemistry to the test.

title: Smiley
overview: Two men and their friends in Barcelona navigate hesitations, hangups and missed connections as they search for the true love they've been missing.

title: The Hook Up Plan
overview: In a misguided attempt to build up perpetually single Elsa's confidence, her friends hire a male escort. A comedy series set in Paris.

title: The Scandal
overview: In Joseon, a secret proposal ignites hidden desires in a gifted noblewoman, a famed lover and an unsuspecting lady caught in their dangerous game.

title: The Ultimatum: France
overview: Six couples on the cusp of lifelong love are hit with an ultimatum: Get engaged or break up. Before they decide, they’ll swap partners for three weeks.

title: To Love, To Lose
overview: A star-crossed romance seals the fate of two families when a woman trying to save her family restaurant falls for the surly heir of a debt collector.

title: Too Much
overview: When a heartbroken New Yorker moves to London hoping for a love story, she falls for an indie musician who's anything but the typical romantic hero.

title: Unlucky Bae
overview: After a drunken ritual goes wrong, Rin accidentally curses an innocent business student. To fix the mess, he stays close — only to fall in love.
